judgment_calls: The heading at L1418 carries authority=root metadata; I did not create a separate heading-metadata node because the authority assignment is already captured by the inherited seed prevent_imminent_harm, and the section's rules are all under that heading. Could have made a node for the heading metadata, but the seed already encodes it.
The examples are each treated as one node demonstrating the rule, not decomposed into the dialog inside them, per the rule that worked-example blocks are one node.
The gas leak example at L1424-1440 and the safety at home example at L1442-1458 are separate nodes because they demonstrate different aspects (avoiding dangerous advice vs. avoiding overstepping).

The knife handling example at L1523-1541 includes three assistant responses (good, bad warning without direction, bad refusal to be helpful); I kept it as one node because it demonstrates the same rule about providing safe direction.
